Affliction is a negative effect that is inflicted on an enemy at the same time as Damage Over Time. All DoT effects share the same Affliction effect. While Affliction lasts on a unit, it gradually accumulates Affliction rating according to the "Affliction Per Second" stat of the one who inflicted DoT effect, up to the maximum of 100 Affliction.

name: Ancient Battleground
summary: The dwarves call this place the Ancient Battleground... Although the scars of battle have been erased by the passage of thousands of years. This place is said to once bear witness to the last glory of my ancestors on the earth, quarrels between brothers, betrayal, and collapse. Anyway, only happy goblins live here now.

When I see how the goblins use the huge weapons of war created by the dwarves to modify their homes and improve their lives, I'm sincerely happy for these former weapons of war. Even if the mountains are cut down by axes, and the ground is hollowed out by drills, the yearning for peace will not be shaken by any forces. In these times of war due to Aember, it is a common belief like this that unites the people.

I drank with the high priest of the goblins, an alcoholic drink made of ancient herbs that they serve to guests. We talked and drank until late at night. Aember sweeps the land with a gale of death and blood. Tonight, we will still sing tuneless praises to the sun of tomorrow, and this is how the people of Leptis live.

name: Block
summary: Block is a defensive mechanic against Hit Damage and Damage Reflection.

When taking a hit or reflecting damage, whether you manage to block successfully depends on the Attack and Spell tags of the damage source, as well as your corresponding Attack and Spell Block Chance. Blocking successfully grants Damage Mitigation based on the Block Ratio and Additional Damage Blocked.

Players have 0%% Block Chance by default. The Block Chance includes the Attack Block Chance and Spell Block Chance. When taking damage, the corresponding tag is applied to determine whether the block is successful or not. The Block Chance from different sources can be stacked up to the maximum Block Chance of 100%%.
Blocking successfully will reduce the corresponding damage taken based on the Block Ratio.
Players' default Block Ratio is 30%%, and the maximum Block Ratio is 60%% by default, up to 80%%.
When the unit also has Additional Damage Blocked, the Block Ratio is calculated before the Additional Damage Blocked.

summary: In Boss Conquest, you will challenge the supreme boss Aureate Calamity Ordrak.
Boss Conquest consists of many ranks and generous rewards. Each rank you conquer takes you closer to the rewards of the next rank.

You get 2 revive chances when you enter Boss Conquest - Rusted Abyss and will lose 1 revive chance when you are defeated or when you leave and re-enter. The challenge ends when you run out of revive chances. The challenge also has a countdown, and it ends when time runs out.
You can challenge Boss Conquest as many times as you like. If you are unhappy with your result, challenge it again to keep improving your result!
You will also receive a daily reward for your first boss challenge made every day. The rewards correspond to your highest rank achieved, so the higher you climb, the better the daily rewards.
If the character is defeated in Boss Conquest while playing in Hardcore Mode or Solo Self Found Hardcore Mode, the character will still remain available for the current season.

name: Calibrate Ethereal Prism
summary: You can use the Prism Calibration feature to add random affixes to an Ethereal Prism.
Each Ethereal Prism has 1 to 3 Random Affix Slots. The third slot is guaranteed to contain an advanced affix with a special effect.
Each calibration presents 3 affix options. Hunters can choose one to confirm, and the affix will then be added to a random affix slot on the Ethereal Prism.
Additionally, Hunters can use the restoration feature to reset an Ethereal Prism to its initial state by spending a certain amount of Flame Elementium.

name: Calibrate Prism
summary: Calibrate Prisms to add random affixes to Ethereal Prisms.

Calibration generates 3 random optional affixes, 1 of which is selected as the final result. Each Prism slot can be calibrated to produce a corresponding type of affix. Slot 1 can be calibrated with a Prism Effect Area affix. Slot 2 can be calibrated with a Prism Additional Effect Affix. Slot 3 can be calibrated with a Prism Legendary Mechanic Affix.
During calibration, a special additional material called Prism Level can be added. Its function is to make it possible to manually refresh the random affix options once.
Prisms that already have 1 or more random affixes can be restored using the restoration feature by spending certain materials. Prisms that have reached the Plasticity upper limit cannot be restored.

name: City Defense
summary: City Defense is a cooperative defensive mode where Hunters must work together to fend off invaders and protect their Core.
City Defense features 7 difficulty levels, each consisting of 15 waves of enemies.
Hunters will receive new rewards for every 3 waves they successfully repel.

In addition to earning rewards, Hunters will also be ranked on a leaderboard. To improve your ranking, aim to clear City Defense at the highest difficulty you can manage and defeat as many waves as quickly as possible.
If the character is defeated in City Defense while playing in Hardcore Mode or Solo Self Found Hardcore Mode, the character will still remain available for the current season.
Rewards for this gameplay can only be claimed in Normal Mode and Solo Self Found Mode on seasonal servers.

summary: There is a chance to deal a Critical Strike when dealing Hit Damage.
There is a chance to deal a Critical Strike when dealing damage. If a skill can deal damage more than once (such as Spiral Strike), the Critical Strike determination is usually only carried out once.

When attacking, the base Critical Strike Rating of the weapon will be factored in when calculating the Critical Strike Rating of the skill. When casting a spell, the base Critical Strike Rating of the spell will be factored in when calculating the Critical Strike Rating of the skill.
Final Critical Strike Rating = The sum of Base Critical Strike Rating x (1 + all non-additional bonus percentages) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 1) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 2)...
Critical Hit Chance = Final Critical Strike Rating/100.

name: Damage Calculation
summary: Damage = Base Damage x (1+ all non-additional bonus percentages) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 1) x (1 + additional bonus percentage 2)...
Similar to the calculation of stats, damage = Base Damage x (1 + all damage increase percentages) x (1 + additional damage increase percentage 1) x (1 + additional damage increase percentage 2)...

name: Damage Form
summary: There are 5 ways to deal damage in the game: Hit Damage, Damage Over Time (DoT), Secondary Damage, Damage Reflection, and True Damage.
Hit Damage is usually dealt by Attacks or Spells and is settled each time. Unless specified, damage dealt by skills is Hit Damage.
The following mechanics can affect Hit Damage:

Accuracy and Evade, Armor, Critical Strike, conversion or addition of the type of damage dealt, conversion of the type of damage taken, Double Damage, Injury Transfer, Injury Buffer, Block, Damage Avoidance, Severe Injury.

name: Damage Mitigation
summary: Additional damage reduction is a defensive mechanic that counteracts all types of damage.
Additional damage reduction from different sources multiplies independently
The maximum Damage Mitigation for each source of additional damage reduction is 90%%.

name: Damage Over Time Reaping
summary: Reaping can settle an equivalent to a certain duration of Damage Over Time acting on a unit.
When Reaping, the active Damage Over Time on the target will be settled at once according to the given time and then deal an equal amount of True Damage.
Reaping only applies to Damage Over Time you deal. The Damage Over Time dealt by other units can't be settled by your Reaping.
Reaping generally has a Recovery Time, which is affected by the Reaping Recovery Speed.
The Damage Over Time duration settled by Reaping is affected by affix bonuses such as: "+X% Reaping Duration".

name: Damage Taken Reduction
summary: Damage mitigation from each independent source can at most reduce the damage taken by 90%.

name: Damage Transfer
summary: Transfers a part of the Hit Damage and Secondary Damage taken to other units.
Up to 60% of the damage taken from each hit can be transferred, and up to 90% of total damage taken can be transferred

name: Damage Type
summary: There are currently 5 types of damage in the game: Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Erosion.
All damage dealt must be one of the following 5 types of damage:
Physical, Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Erosion
Except for Physical Damage, all other types of damage are affected by their corresponding Resistances.

name: Damage Type Conversion
summary: When dealing or taking damage, the type of the damage can be converted into another type.
Conversion of the Type of Damage Dealt
The type of damage dealt can be converted. For example, "Converts 50% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage".
Only Hit Damage can be converted.

From low to high, the priority of damage types is as follows: Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Erosion. Upon inflicting damage, the damage type can only be converted from a lower-priority damage type to a higher-priority damage type.

If the sum of the conversion percentages of multiple damage types from the same source exceeds 100%, such as when "Converts 60% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage" and "Converts 60% of Physical Damage to Cold Damage" take effect at the same time, the final converted damage will not exceed 100%, and the damage will be redistributed according to their weighted percentages.

1. The Dream Cloud Atlas has many nodes, which can unlock or change features of the Twinightmare gameplay, or increase the rewards of this mode.

2. There are 2 types of nodes: inner nodes and outer nodes. For each point you allocate to inner nodes, you must allocate 2 points to outer nodes before you can allocate more points to inner nodes, and vice versa. The 2 initial points for inner nodes and the last 10 points for outer nodes are not subject to this restriction.

3. Each node has a corresponding Lotus Seed activation cost. Every time you pass a Sweet Dream's trial, the Lotus Seed Progress will be increased by 1. The progress will be displayed right below your current number of Lotus Seeds on the screen. When the progress is full, you will gain 1 Lotus Seed. Lotus Seed Progress will no longer be increased or displayed after you have gained enough Lotus Seeds to activate all the nodes.

name: Dwarf King
summary: I sneaked into the group that was going to meet the Dwarf King, just to see that young king reveling in the attention of being surrounded by thousands.

But he is blind. I mean, he has been blinded by the glory of the ancient dwarves and the flames of desire ignited by the Spark, and thus he cannot see what is occurring right by his side. He speaks of the Dwarven Kingdom's future, yet he exhausts its present.

I think it's time to put an end to my journey. After reading through what my ancestors left to the world, I have fully understood the history of the Epoch of Might. Maybe I will write it all down in the near future.

I have translated my ancestors' words into the common tongue of this land. I may have altered the style a little, but the content has remained mostly unchanged. I hope one day someone will find out those words from my journal. The sacrifice of heroes must be remembered by the world.

name: Ill Omen Base Mechanics
summary: Ill Omen is an exclusive Damage Over Time mechanic. Dealing Damage Over Time to Cursed monsters will stack Ill Omen. When Ill Omen is triggered, all Ill Omen stacks are consumed to eliminate non-Elite enemies or deal lots of True Damage to Elite enemies.
The base Max Stacks of Ill Omen is 10 stacks. Inflicts 1 stack of Ill Omen whenever the cumulative Damage Over Time dealt to a monster reaches the trigger threshold.
Non-Elite enemies: Single-stack trigger threshold = 8% of the Max Life of non-Elite enemies.
Elite enemies: Single-stack trigger threshold = 5% of the Max Life of Elite enemies.
Ill Omen is triggered upon reaching max stacks, consuming all Ill Omen stacks to instantly eliminate non-Elite enemies and deal True Damage equal to 20% of Max Life to Elite enemies.
Supreme bosses will only trigger Ill Omen once.

name: Ill Omen Trigger Effect
summary: Through character progression, Ill Omen can gain additional effects such as Spread, Restoration, Movement Speed, etc., when triggered.
Triggering Ill Omen inflicts Ill Omen stacks on nearby non-Elite enemies.
Triggering Ill Omen grants Life Restoration, increased Movement Speed, Damage Over Time bonuses, and other additional buffs, helping DoT builds stay alive and mobile where they usually struggle.

name: Pactspirit Rally
summary: 1. During the event, purchasing this feature grants account-wide access to Rally Pactspirits for the current season.

2. You can select 3 different sets of Drop Pactspirits from the Pactspirit pool for support. Each set contains 1 T1 Legendary, 1 T4 Rare, and 1 T6 Magic Pactspirit corresponding to the season-exclusive gameplay.

3. Once selected, the set of Rally Pactspirits will be added to your Pactspirit List as independent limited-time Pactspirits with exclusive tags. The tiers of Rally Pactspirits and owned Pactspirits do not affect each other.

4. After a set is first selected and after every subsequent change, you must wait 24 hours before changing it again. The cooldown for each set is calculated independently. Upon changing, the original Rally Pactspirits will be removed, and any active pacts will be automatically canceled.

5. Rally Pactspirits can follow you or form a pact on the Shortcut Tab or Regular Tab of the Pact. Once they form a pact, their effects apply according to their tier and skill descriptions. Rally Pactspirits and owned Pactspirits of the same name can be chosen freely, but cannot form a pact simultaneously.
6. Rally Pactspirits cannot be upgraded or exchanged into Insight Essences.

name: Resistance
summary: +1% chance to avoid Elemental Ailments for every 1% effective Erosion Resistance
Resistance is an effective survival mechanic that directly reduces the corresponding type of damage taken by a certain percentage.

There are 4 types of Resistance: Fire Resistance, Lightning Resistance, Cold Resistance, and Erosion Resistance. Fire Resistance, Lightning Resistance, and Cold Resistance are collectively referred to as Elemental Resistance.
When monsters deal a large amount of damage, it is mainly Elemental Damage, so increasing your Elemental Resistance will effectively reduce a large amount of Elemental Damage you'll take from them.

name: Resistance Penetration
summary: When calculating the damage, the defender's Resistance is calculated at a lower value.
As a stat that counteracts Resistance, Resistance Penetration acts on the defender's effective Resistance in the damage calculation process.

Upon inflicting damage, if the attacker has Resistance Penetration of a certain type, the defender's Resistance will be reduced accordingly by the value of the Resistance Penetration when calculating the damage.
Resistance Penetration does not change the actual value of the defender's Resistance.
Resistance Penetration takes effect on all forms of damage (Hit, DoT, Secondary, Reflect).

name: Skill Level
summary: The Base Damage and affix effects of skills increase with the skill level. Defeat enemies to gain Skill XP, which can be used to upgrade skills to Lv.20.
The Base Damage and affix effects of skills increase with the skill level. Defeat enemies to gain Skill XP, which can be used to upgrade skills to Lv.20.
Some special effects, such as affixes or drop skills also increase the skill level. This makes it possible for the actual level of skills to exceed Lv.20.

After the skill exceeds Lv. 20, its Base Damage and the Base Damage of its Minions will no longer change. However, for every level beyond this level, this skill and its Minions will gain additional damage. At Lv. 21 - 30, each level +10%% additional damage (multiplies) At Lv. 31 or higher, each level +8%% additional damage (multiplies).
For example: If the skill's current level is Lv.21, this skill deals an additional +10%% damage when it is higher than Lv.1.

name: Skill Slot Info
summary: The skill slots determine the number of skills that can be installed.
Skill slots need to be unlocked with Energy automatically or manually.

Other skill slots need to be manually unlocked by allocating Energy.
Energy can be obtained through character upgrade and gear installation (except Trinkets).

name: Skill Slots

Active Skill slots include the first 5 skill slots on the Skill panel. Active Skill slots can also be sorted from top to bottom.
The Active Skill equipped in the first skill slot is known as the Main Skill.

name: TOWER Sequence
summary: The TOWER Sequence system can be used to research sequences for non-Legendary weapons (including shields). Sequences are special affixes that don't replace existing base affixes.
After the TOWER Sequence feature is unlocked as you progress through the main story, you can perform R&D on weapons (including shields) at [ROOT].
To perform R&D, Hunters must spend a set number of Mods.

Once initiated, each round presents a random selection of colored Chips to choose from. If the selected Chip colors (in any order) match a target sequence, the R&D succeeds, granting the weapon the corresponding effects. If the colors do not match any sequence, the R&D fails.

There are 2 types of R&D: Basic R&D and In-Depth R&D. Basic R&D only requires Hunters to choose 3 Chips, whereas In-Depth R&D requires Hunters to choose 4. Basic R&D only yields Intermediate sequences. Advanced sequences can only be obtained from In-Depth R&D. Each weapon can only have 1 sequence, but Hunters can perform R&D repeatedly until the desired target sequence is obtained.
Consumed materials will not be returned if R&D is interrupted.

Activating each Talent Node on the Talent Panel costs Talent Points.
You gain 1 Talent Node every time when you level up. Additionally, you can obtain additional Talent Nodes by completing key quests.
Talent Nodes in the Talent Panel consist of Minor Nodes, Medium Nodes, and Major Nodes.

name: Tarot Path
summary: Complete the Tarot Trials a certain number of times in Netherrealm stages to enter the Tarot Path and collect Chests of Destiny.
1. The Tarot Path unlocks after you complete enough Tarot Trials in the stage.
2. Various Cells exist in the Tarot Path, and you move along the path by using the Notes of Arcana in your hand. When you stop on a Cell, you will trigger the effect of the corresponding Cell.
3. When you stay on a Cell with a Chest of Destiny on it, you will collect it. You can only carry 7 Chests of Destiny at any one time.

4. Chests of Destiny come in 6 rarities: Green, Blue, Purple, Orange, Red, and Rainbow. The rarity of Chests of Destiny can be enhanced by using Notes of Arcana or by triggering random events on the Cells.

5. After collecting Chests of Destiny, Hunters can choose to start Fateful Contest at any time. After completing the corresponding number of Tarot Trials in Fateful Contest, Chests of Destiny can be opened to claim their rewards.

name: Type Changed

name: Type Conversion
summary: All Drop Quantity bonuses are applied before the conversion. Converted items are no longer affected by these bonuses.
This type of attributes refers to things like "Gear drops have a X% chance to become Flame Fuel," "Gear drops have a X% chance to become Flame Elementium," etc.
All Drop Quantity bonuses are applied before the conversion. Converted items are no longer affected by these bonuses.

Note: If the total conversion chance for a type of item exceeds 100%, the conversion chance will be weighted so that the total chance remains 100%. For example, if "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel" and "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Ember" are applied at the same time, the gear drop will have a 50% chance to become 1 set of Fuel and 50% chance to become 1 set of Ember.
Calculation (using the conversion of a piece of gear to Fuel as an example)

Example 1: If a certain drop originally has a 100% chance to drop 10 pieces of gear, with "Gear drops have a 100% chance to become 1 set of Fuel", there is a 100% chance to drop 10 sets of Fuel (this Fuel can be any Fuel item, such as Flame Sand x1, Flame Elementium x1, Flame Elementium x10, etc., and the same applies below)

summary: After starting the Vigil, you must defeat the Wraiths swarming around the Undead Vigil Procession within the time limit.

During the Vigil, your Guiding Lantern draws Wraiths in and signals the current battle intensity.

Guiding Lantern: Stable (Blue)-The faster you defeat Wraiths, the faster they spawn. Guiding Lantern: Flickering (Yellow)-Wraiths are starting to pile up. Thin them out before it gets worse. Guiding Lantern: Overloaded (Red)-Too many Wraiths are on the field. Spawning is paused. Clear them fast or risk losing rewards. At the Usher Mortuary, you can spend Remnant Souls to awaken Relics. Once awakened, there's a chance Vigil Anomalies and Noble Coffins will appear during runs-some of them can shake up the rules and greatly improve drops.
